ranking_audit.title_en: Sharp Higher Integrability Theory, Part I: The $L^p$-norm of the Beurling--Ahlfors transform
ranking_audit.title_zh: 尖锐高可积性理论，第一部分：Beurling–Ahlfors 变换的 $L^p$ 范数
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: First for its exact norm in a central singular-integral conjecture and the variational mechanism behind it.

ranking_audit.title_en: A Szemerédi-Trotter Theorem in Arbitrary Fields
ranking_audit.title_zh: 任意域上的 Szemerédi–Trotter 定理
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Second for the sharp incidence exponent and direct finite-field restriction consequences; only the in-week version is ranked.

ranking_audit.title_en: Establishing the Polynomial Wolff Axioms for $\delta$-Separated $\delta$-Tubes With #o-minimality
ranking_audit.title_zh: 利用 #o-极小性建立方向 $\delta$-分离的 $\delta$-管的多项式 Wolff 公理
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Third for removing the epsilon loss in a core Kakeya non-concentration input with quantitative complexity control.

ranking_audit.title_en: Sharp $L^p$ estimates for the strong spherical maximal operator
ranking_audit.title_zh: 强球面极大算子的尖锐 $L^p$ 估计
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Fourth for completing the stated strong spherical maximal range; preliminary AI-assisted proof status tempers confidence.

ranking_audit.title_en: Sharp lower bounds for the periodic maximal Schrödinger operator in higher dimensions
ranking_audit.title_zh: 高维周期 Schrödinger 极大算子的尖锐下界
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Fifth for the sharp periodic convergence threshold and new arithmetic construction; the critical endpoint remains open.

ranking_audit.title_en: The Solution to Agmon's Conjecture for the polylaplacian
ranking_audit.title_zh: 多重 Laplace 算子的 Agmon 猜想的解
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Sixth for the new higher-order layer-potential machinery across dimensions, subject to explicit boundary hypotheses.

ranking_audit.title_en: Sharp endpoint extension inequalities for the moment curve on finite fields II: an extremal property of the uniform distribution
ranking_audit.title_zh: 有限域上矩曲线的尖锐端点延拓不等式 II：均匀分布的极值性质
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for exact constants and all equality cases in a finite-field endpoint extension problem.

ranking_audit.title_en: On $C^k$ convex variants of Stein's Weighted $L^2$ Conjecture for Bochner-Riesz means
ranking_audit.title_zh: Stein 关于 Bochner–Riesz 平均的加权 $L^2$ 猜想的 $C^k$ 凸体变体
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for counterexamples clarifying which geometric weighted multiplier conjectures can hold.

ranking_audit.title_en: An improved high-low method for the parabola
ranking_audit.title_zh: 抛物线的一种改进的高低频方法
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for a reusable improvement of the high-low proof method, without claiming new numerical exponents.

ranking_audit.title_en: Mollified disc multipliers
ranking_audit.title_zh: 经磨光的圆盘乘子
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for sharp logarithmic endpoint growth of planar disc regularizations.

ranking_audit.title_en: Global well-posedness and scattering for the three-dimensional focusing energy-critical NLS
ranking_audit.title_zh: 三维聚焦能量临界 NLS 的整体适定性与散射
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for the claimed full subthreshold focusing NLS result in the natural homogeneous energy space.

ranking_audit.title_en: Sharp weighted weak-type bounds for commutators of singular integrals
ranking_audit.title_zh: 奇异积分交换子的尖锐加权弱型界
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for optimal weight powers and a meaningful distinction between generic and logarithmic BMO symbols.

ranking_audit.title_en: Complex median method
ranking_audit.title_zh: 复中位数方法
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for a method removing a real-valued-symbol obstruction in commutator necessity.

ranking_audit.title_en: Rough spectral asymptotics for commutators of general singular integrals
ranking_audit.title_zh: 一般奇异积分交换子的粗谱渐近
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for extending spectral asymptotic control to general singular integrals, with the liminf/limsup limitation explicit.

ranking_audit.title_en: Formalizing Carleson's Theorem in Lean
ranking_audit.title_zh: 在 Lean 中形式化 Carleson 定理
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected as a substantial HA formalization exposition and reusable verification infrastructure, not as autonomous AI discovery.

ranking_audit.title_en: Sharp Matrix $\mathcal A_p$ lower bounds for general non-degenerate convolution Calderón--Zygmund operators
ranking_audit.title_zh: 一般非退化卷积 Calderón–Zygmund 算子的尖锐矩阵 $\mathcal A_p$ 下界
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for a general sharp matrix-weight obstruction and precise matrix-dimension hypotheses.

ranking_audit.title_en: Besicovitch Compression and a Quantitative Failure of Endpoint Fourier Restriction
ranking_audit.title_zh: Besicovitch 压缩与端点 Fourier 限制估计的定量失效
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for deterministic quantitative endpoint failure rather than merely qualitative obstruction.

ranking_audit.title_en: Absolute continuity and dimension conservation for self-similar sets and measures
ranking_audit.title_zh: 自相似集与测度的绝对连续性及维数守恒
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for all-direction projection consequences without a uniform spectral gap; constrained to in-week hypotheses.

ranking_audit.title_en: Infinite cascades for the defocusing cubic half-wave equation on the torus
ranking_audit.title_zh: 环面上散焦三次半波方程的无限级联
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for an explicit sustained high-frequency cascade in a defocusing periodic dispersive model.

ranking_audit.title_en: Favard length of non-homogeneous random disc-like Cantor sets
ranking_audit.title_zh: 非齐次随机类圆盘 Cantor 集的 Favard 长度
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for sharpness examples across the full range of capacity-based projection decay.

ranking_audit.title_en: Stable solutions of the Allen--Cahn equation in dimension three are one-dimensional
ranking_audit.title_zh: 三维 Allen–Cahn 方程的稳定解是一维的
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: First general item for a central stability classification and four-dimensional corollary, with earlier independent provenance stated.

ranking_audit.title_en: Semifields in prime dimensions and counterexamples to Kaplansky's conjecture
ranking_audit.title_zh: 素数维数的半域与 Kaplansky 猜想的反例
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Second general item for an explicit infinite counterexample family to a longstanding finite-algebra classification.

ranking_audit.title_en: Dictators are most informative
ranking_audit.title_zh: 独裁函数保留的信息最多
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Third general item for the universal Boolean-information conjecture; independent proof and stability work are grouped.

ranking_audit.title_en: Sharper Bounds for the Complex Grothendieck Constant
ranking_audit.title_zh: 复 Grothendieck 常数的更精确界
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for simultaneous quantitative progress on both sides of a central functional-analytic constant.

ranking_audit.title_en: Counterexamples to the inhomogeneous Duffin-Schaeffer Conjecture
ranking_audit.title_zh: 非齐次 Duffin–Schaeffer 猜想的反例
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected as the representative of two overlapping inhomogeneous approximation counterexample papers; companion provenance is retained.

ranking_audit.title_en: Lipschitz-free spaces are strongly unique preduals
ranking_audit.title_zh: Lipschitz 自由空间是强唯一预对偶
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for an arbitrary-metric-space resolution of the strongly unique predual question.

ranking_audit.title_en: On the transcendental Yau-Tian-Donaldson Conjecture
ranking_audit.title_zh: 论超越型 Yau–Tian–Donaldson 猜想
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for extending the stability/existence correspondence to transcendental Kähler classes with the automorphism restriction.

ranking_audit.title_en: Proof of the Kahn Saks Conjecture
ranking_audit.title_zh: Kahn–Saks 猜想的证明
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected for a full large-width poset conjecture and its stronger structural dichotomy.

ranking_audit.title_en: Notes on a strongly aperiodic monotile in $E^3$
ranking_audit.title_zh: $E^3$ 中强非周期单瓷砖的札记
ranking_audit.selection_rationale: Selected AI item because the in-week specialist reconstruction materially improves verification of an AI-discovered object and has reputable September 23 Quanta coverage.
ranking_audit.event_type: new specialist exposition and material verification update (v1); independent coverage 2026-09-23
